summary: 3D rhythm game with an Ottoman mehter band, redesigned as a dusk square in crimson, gold and deep green with arcaded houses, banners and a mosque, built by Claude Haiku 5.5 · Osmanlı mehter takımıyla 3D ritim oyunu, kızıl, altın ve koyu yeşil alacakaranlık meydanı, kemerli evler, sancaklar ve camiyle yeniden tasarlandı, Claude Haiku 5.5 yaptı
key_features: Six marches on four lanes: press D F J K on the beat or tap the lanes; hold long zurna notes; combos raise the multiplier
Redesign: arcaded houses with gold cornices, canvas-painted banners, a mosque at the far end and torches that swell on every beat
Redesign: a gilded hit line, crimson-and-gold panels with tuğra-style dividers, drum sticks and zil that move with the notes
An input-lag calibration screen; the language follows the browser (Turkish or English)
Measured after the redesign: 60 fps, 31 draw calls; the ?auto bot hits all 907 notes of the last song perfectly with 0 JS errors
